headings.font_family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Clash Display, sans-serif

rules: NO INTER FOR MAIN HEADINGS. Rotate to Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit.
Max hero heading size ceiling: text-5xl on desktop.
Maintain tight tracking (tracking-tight) on headings 24px and above.
Labels and tabular headers MUST be uppercase with letter spacing tracking-wider.

layout_and_grid.density: High Density Grid (Mode B for Dashboards & Finance Workspaces)
layout_and_grid.sidebar: Fixed desktop left sidebar (w-64) with collapsible mobile overlay nav
layout_and_grid.header: Top glassmorphism bar (h-16 backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border-b border-border/50 sticky top-0 z-40)

key_features_and_flows.title: Dashboard Penjualan & Summary
key_features_and_flows.description: North Star metric hero (Total Omzet, Cashflow Net, Pending Piutang, Document Audit Pass Rate) with quick filters and interactive revenue/expense charts.

key_features_and_flows.title: Upload Dokumen & AI Extraction
key_features_and_flows.description: Drag-and-drop document vault (PDF/Image invoice, receipt, tax form). Live OCR/AI breakdown simulating line item extraction, confidence scores, and instant verification.

key_features_and_flows.title: Validasi Transaksi
key_features_and_flows.description: Rule-based and AI anomaly detection for transaction records, flag duplicates, tax discrepancies, and mismatch alerts with one-click approval/rejection.

key_features_and_flows.title: Database Invoice
key_features_and_flows.description: Searchable, filterable ledger with status tags (Paid, Pending, Overdue, Disputed), bulk actions, export capabilities, and quick detail modal.

key_features_and_flows.title: Invoice Generator Profesional
key_features_and_flows.description: Interactive live invoice designer with customized layout, tax calculation, client selection, itemized pricing, logo upload simulation, and PDF preview/download.

key_features_and_flows.title: Laporan Otomatis
key_features_and_flows.description: Profit & Loss statement, Balance sheet summary, Tax estimation report (PPN/PPh), with automated AI summary notes and download capabilities.

key_features_and_flows.title: Manajemen Customer & Produk
key_features_and_flows.description: Dual tab interface for client directories with credit limits and product/service catalog with stock/pricing controls.

key_features_and_flows.title: Manajemen Piutang (Accounts Receivable)
key_features_and_flows.description: Aging schedule breakdown (0-30 days, 31-60 days, 60+ days), automated payment reminder trigger, and risk score indicator.

key_features_and_flows.title: AI Financial Assistant
key_features_and_flows.description: Interactive AI Chatbot panel answering financial questions, forecasting revenue trends, drafting tax suggestions, and explaining ledger discrepancies in Indonesian.

testing_and_attributes.required_data_testid_convention: kebab-case functional identifiers on every interactive element and data card

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, links, inputs, tabs, dropdowns) have explicit hover, active, and focus states.
Do NOT rely on transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, tooltips, or overlays — always set dark or light solid surface backgrounds with thin subtle borders.
File extension note: Project uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files. Write React code adhering to JSX specs.
Provide demo mock datasets in local JS state/constants for realistic Indonesian financial context (IDR currency, PPN 11%, PT standard corporate names).
Integrate 'sonner' toast notifications for instant feedback on document uploads, invoice status changes, and AI extraction completions.
